behavior: Fresh genuine authentication reads a bounded chronological calendar, scoped saved job/current and latest appointments, and consecutive immutable history prefixes. Foreign-business reads and signed-out reads fail; raw web table access remains denied.

Proposed times remain separate from confirmed reservations. Prepared messages remain prepared; cancellation communication is an owner-recorded fact. A previously selected history prefix remains stable when a later change is retained.

A saved-job ZIP contains CSV, normalized JSON, escape maps, a dictionary and independently verifiable part hashes. It rejects missing/mixed/substituted histories and does not claim original hash inputs, complete reference closure, a business export or backup.

All twelve new physical tables expose every one of154 independently checked database columns through the export credential on READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ. Scoped page cursors and held-snapshot tokens are verified. Web/raw access and unsafe grants are denied.

Physical source CSV preserves original PostgreSQL JSONB text including nested numeric scale1.000, integer cents, microsecond timestamps, null versus literal backslashes, formula-leading text and Unicode. Neutral CSV reimport and PostgreSQL JSONB comparison pass.

regression.cause: Archive incorrectly equated event recordedAt with the job update timestamp although the event is inserted afterward.
regression.fix: Bind the final job state/actor/operation and command effective timestamp; preserve the later event recorded timestamp independently.
regression.unitCoverage: Distinct effective/recorded timestamps are retained and genuine multi-version cancelled-job ZIP retrieval passes.

limitations: No booking HTTP/UI activation, registered50 adoption or new preview deployment.
Complete actor/operation/audit/commercial source closure, original-save retirement and legacy49 recovery helpers remain required before adoption.
A global pending-change queue outside the current confirmed calendar window still requires integration.

No full current-source public CI or new browser/physical-device acceptance. Field/custody/photos, finance posting/reporting, complete portability/recovery and Google Calendar remain approved unfinished V1 scope.
